market_bond_exposure.note: In-sample descriptive regression, not investable residual alpha or causal attribution.

limitations: Adjusted historical prices, whole-share research proxy, not raw corporate-action accounting
USD pretax; no CAD FX, XEQT, account-specific taxes or withholding
